pairsWith.noteUz: a/an/some, some/any, much/many, a few/a little coursebook 42-bet 12-13-mashqlar va qoidaga; restoran lug'ati coursebook 43-bet 15-16-mashqlarga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 6-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (27-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Food, Glorious Food' va to'q sariq '6'.

CHAP USTUN:
6) 'Fill in the correct word in the list.' Qiya: 'dessert, bill, order, main course, starving'. 1 Are you ready to ...... sir? 2 Shall we order now? I'm ...... . 3 Could I have the ...... please? 4 I'd like grilled chicken for the ...... . 5 I'll have some strawberries for ...... .
• 'Grammar':
7) 'Fill in a, an or some.' 1 ...... cheese 2 ...... apple 3 ...... onion 4 ...... sandwich 5 ...... bread 6 ...... doughnut 7 ...... orange 8 ...... tomato 9 ...... egg 10 ...... spaghetti 11 ...... banana 12 ...... cherries.
8) 'Look at the list of foods in Sarah's fridge, then make sentences using some or any, as in the examples.' RO'YXAT: ✓ meat, ✗ carrots, ✗ ice cream, ✓ eggs, ✓ yoghurt, ✗ butter, ✓ Coke, ✗ milk, ✓ grapes, ✗ strawberries, ✗ mayonnaise, ✓ sausages. Qiya namuna: 'There is some meat in the fridge. There aren't any carrots in the fridge.'
9) 'Underline the correct word in bold.' 1 How many/much biscuits would you like? 2 There isn't many/much sugar in this tea. 3 How many/much chocolates did you eat? 4 I didn't use many/much eggs to make the omelette. 5 There isn't many/much milk left. 6 How many/much hot dogs would you like? 7 You didn't put many/much salt in the soup. 8 How many/much bacon do you need? 9 There isn't many/much lettuce in this salad. 10 We haven't got many/much wine for the party.
10) 'Put the words in the list below into the appropriate columns.' Qiya: 'raisins, cake, flour, sweets, sandwiches, cereal, peaches, ham, mushrooms, marmalade'. JADVAL: a few / a little.

O'NG USTUN:
11) 'Correct the mistakes, as in the example.' 1 There aren't much (chizilgan) carrots left. ...many... 2 There are any eggs in the fridge. 3 There is a few tea left in the teapot. 4 Would you like a apple? 5 Is there many cheese left? 6 Do you want an hamburger? 7 How much oranges do you need? 8 There are a little grapes left in the fridge. 9 Are there some olives on that pizza? 10 Would you like some doughnut?
12) 'Fill in the correct word from the list.' Qiya A: 'any, an, a, some'. A: Would you like 1) ...... orange? B: No, thanks. I'd rather have 2) ...... coffee. A: Sorry, there isn't 3) ...... coffee left. How about 4) ...... glass of milk? B: Sure. Qiya B: 'many, much, a few, a little, some'. A: How 1) ...... cheese do you need? B: Just 2) ...... . We only have 3) ...... eggs left, though. A: Okay. I'll buy 4) ......, then. How 5) ...... shall I get? B: I think six will be enough.
13) 'Tick (✓) the correct sentences.' 1 a) Can I have an egg, please? ✓ b) Can I have some egg, please? 2 a) Would you like any milk? b) Would you like some milk? 3 a) Is there many ice cream left? b) Is there any ice cream left? 4 a) We don't need many strawberries. b) We don't need much strawberries. 5 a) I'd like a little sugar please. b) I'd like a few sugar please. 6 a) Would you like a meat? b) Would you like some meat? 7 a) There are a few biscuits left. b) There are a little biscuits left. 8 a) There isn't many juice in the fridge. b) There isn't much juice in the fridge. 9 a) I'd like a Coke, please. b) I'd like some Coke, please. 10 a) Is there any ketchup? b) Is there some ketchup?

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '27'.

exercises.explanationUz:
RESTORANDA (coursebook 43-bet
  15-16-mashqlar).

  Are you ready to ORDER? =
    buyurtma berishga tayyormisiz?

    o'layapman
  Could I have the BILL? = hisobni

⚠ 'STARVING':

⚠ 'THE BILL':

⚠ 'GRILLED CHICKEN':

  = grilda pishirilgan tovuq.


⚠ 'SHALL WE ...?':

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an or some.
exercises.explanationUz:
A / AN / SOME (coursebook 42-bet
  12-mashq).

  A + sanaladigan, undosh:
    a sandwich, a doughnut, a
    tomato, a banana
  AN + sanaladigan, unli:
    an apple, an onion, an orange,
    an egg
  SOME + sanalmas yoki ko'plik:
    some cheese, some bread, some
    spaghetti, some cherries


⚠ SANALMAS OTLAR:

  cheese, bread, spaghetti - 'a'
  BILAN ISHLATILMAYDI.


⚠ 'CHERRIES':

  = gilos (ko'plik) → 'some'.


⚠ 'ONION':

  /ˈʌnjən/ - unli bilan → 'an'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the list of foods in Sarah's fridge, then make sentences using some or any, as in the examples. ✓ meat, ✗ carrots, ✗ ice cream, ✓ eggs, ✓ yoghurt, ✗ butter, ✓ Coke, ✗ milk, ✓ grapes, ✗ strawberries, ✗ mayonnaise, ✓ sausages.
exercises.instructionUz: Saraning muzlatgichidagi ovqatlar ro'yxatiga qarang, so'ng some yoki any bilan gaplar tuzing, namunalardagidek. ✓ meat, ✗ carrots, ✗ ice cream, ✓ eggs, ✓ yoghurt, ✗ butter, ✓ Coke, ✗ milk, ✓ grapes, ✗ strawberries, ✗ mayonnaise, ✓ sausages.
exercises.explanationUz:
SOME / ANY (coursebook 42-bet
  qoidasi).

  TASDIQ: There is/are SOME ...
  INKOR: There isn't/aren't ANY ...

  ⚠ IS / ARE:
  sanalmas → IS: 'There is some
    meat', 'There isn't any milk'
  ko'plik → ARE: 'There are some
    eggs', 'There aren't any
    carrots'


RO'YXAT:

  ✓ (bor): meat, eggs, yoghurt,
    Coke, grapes, sausages
  ✗ (yo'q): carrots, ice cream,
    butter, milk, strawberries,
    mayonnaise


⚠ 'MAYONNAISE':

  = mayonez. /ˌmeɪəˈneɪz/.
exercises.exampleEn: There is some meat in the fridge. There aren't any carrots in the fridge.
exercises.exampleUz: Muzlatgichda go'sht bor. Muzlatgichda sabzi yo'q.

exercises.instructionEn: Underline the correct word in bold.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin harfli to'g'ri so'zning tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MANY / MUCH (coursebook 42-bet
  qoidasi).

  MANY + SANALADIGAN ko'plik:
    biscuits, chocolates, eggs, hot
    dogs
  MUCH + SANALMAS:
    sugar, milk, salt, bacon,
    lettuce, wine

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham SO'ROQ va INKORDA.


⚠ 'HOW MANY / HOW MUCH':

  How many biscuits? (nechta)
  How much bacon? (qancha)


⚠ 'LEFT':

  = qolgan. 'There isn't much milk
  left' = sut kam qoldi.


⚠ 'BACON':

  = bekon (cho'chqa go'shti) -
  sanalmas.

exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni mos ustunlarga joylashtiring: a few / a little. raisins, cake, flour, sweets, sandwiches, cereal, peaches, ham, mushrooms, marmalade
exercises.explanationUz:
A FEW / A LITTLE (coursebook
  42-bet qoidasi).

  A FEW + SANALADIGAN ko'plik
    (bir nechta): raisins, sweets,
    sandwiches, peaches, mushrooms
  A LITTLE + SANALMAS (ozgina):
    cake, flour, cereal, ham,
    marmalade


⚠ 'RAISINS':

  = mayiz (ko'plik).


⚠ 'MARMALADE':

  = sitrus murabbosi (apelsin) -
  sanalmas.


⚠ 'HAM':

  = vetchina (cho'chqa go'shti) -
  sanalmas.


⚠ 'MUSHROOMS':

  = qo'ziqorinlar (ko'plik).

exercises.instructionEn: Correct the mistakes, as in the example. Example: There aren't much carrots left. - many
exercises.instructionUz: Xatolarni namunadagidek tuzating. Namuna: There aren't much carrots left. - many
exercises.explanationUz:
XATOLARNI TUZATISh - MIQDOR
  SO'ZLARI JAMLANMASI.

  1 carrots (ko'plik) → MANY
  2 tasdiq gap → SOME
  3 tea (sanalmas) → A LITTLE
  4 apple (unli) → AN
  5 cheese (sanalmas) → MUCH
  6 hamburger (undosh) → A
  7 oranges (ko'plik) → MANY
  8 grapes (ko'plik) → A FEW
  9 so'roq → ANY
  10 doughnut (birlik, sanaladigan)
     → A


⚠ 'ANY' - SO'ROQ va INKORDA;
  'SOME' - TASDIQDA va TAKLIFDA
  ('Would you like some ...?').


⚠ 'A TEAPOT':

  = choynak.


⚠ 'OLIVES':

  = zaytunlar.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list: any, an, a, some.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'zni qo'ying: any, an, a, some.
exercises.explanationUz:
A / AN / SOME / ANY - DIALOG.

  'AN orange' - unli
  'A coffee' - og'zaki: bir
    piyola qahva ('a cup of coffee')
  'isn't ANY coffee' - inkor
  'A glass of milk' - bir stakan


⚠ 'I'D RATHER HAVE':

  = afzal ko'rardim, ... olganim
  ma'qul.


⚠ 'HOW ABOUT ...?':

  = ... chi? (taklif).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: No, thanks. I'd rather have 2) ___ coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sorry, there isn't 3) ___ coffee left. How about 4) ___ glass of milk?
lines.uz: Kechirasiz, qahva qolmagan. Bir stakan sut-chi?
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Inkor → 'any'. 'a glass of milk' - bir stakan.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list: many, much, a few, a little, some.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'zni qo'ying: many, much, a few, a little, some.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUCH / A LITTLE / A FEW / SOME /
  MANY - DIALOG.

  'How MUCH cheese' - sanalmas
  'Just A LITTLE' - ozgina (cheese)
  'A FEW eggs' - bir nechta (ko'plik)
  'I'll buy SOME' - tasdiq (eggs)
  'How MANY shall I get?' - nechta
    (eggs)


⚠ 'THOUGH' (gap oxirida):

  = lekin, ammo. 'We only have a
  few eggs left, though.'


⚠ 'SHALL I ...?':

  = ... qilaymi? (taklif/so'rash).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Just 2) ___ . We only have 3) ___ eggs left, though.
lines.uz: Ozgina. Lekin bizda bir nechta tuxum qolgan, xolos.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Okay. I'll buy 4) ___, then. How 5) ___ shall I get?
lines.uz: Xo'p. Unda tuxum olaman. Nechta olay?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I think six will be enough.

exercises.explanationUz:
TO'G'RI GAPNI TANLASh - 6-UNIT
  GRAMMATIKASI JAMLANMASI.

  1 an egg (sanaladigan) ✓
  2 some milk (taklif → some) ✓
  3 any ice cream (sanalmas, so'roq)
    ✓
  4 many strawberries (ko'plik) ✓
  5 a little sugar (sanalmas) ✓
  6 some meat (sanalmas, 'a' EMAS)
    ✓
  7 a few biscuits (ko'plik) ✓
  8 much juice (sanalmas) ✓
  9 a Coke (og'zaki - bir shisha/
    banka) ✓
  10 any ketchup (so'roq) ✓


⚠ 'WOULD YOU LIKE SOME ...?':

  Taklifda 'some' (any EMAS).


⚠ 'A COKE':

  = bir Coca-Cola (banka/shisha) -
  og'zaki nutqda mumkin.
